title: OpenCode V2 binding launch values
description: Values passed individually as ELIOT_SWARM_CONFIG_<KEY>; they are copied from the exact immutable OpenCode route and are not synthesized by the supervisor. Only service, connection and directory are mandatory; the native harness supplies provider/model/variant defaults unless the caller passes an explicit complete override trio.

OPENCODE_SERVICE_ID.description: Operator-stable OpenCode service namespace; independent of native PID and GM incarnation.

OPENCODE_CONNECTION_FILE.description: Absolute native path, verified by the supervisor for the current operating system.

OPENCODE_DIRECTORY.description: Absolute native path, verified by the supervisor for the current operating system.

OPENCODE_MODEL_ID.description: Optional explicit native model override; requires the complete provider/model/variant trio, never defaulted.

OPENCODE_PROVIDER_ID.description: Case-sensitive OpenCode providerID for an explicit override trio; no alias or default.

OPENCODE_VARIANT.description: Optional explicit native variant override; requires the complete provider/model/variant trio, never defaulted.
